evidence.reason: The alleged failure requires an existing retained target to be corrupted after creation. In the supplied code, `target` is only created by atomically renaming a fully written temp directory after all artifact hashes are computed, and the target name is the digest of that manifest. No in-process path creates an existing target with truncated artifacts; detecting later out-of-band corruption by revalidating manifests/digests is a hardening addition, not an implementation error in current intended behavior. No supplied caller contract requires digest revalidation on deduplicated reuse.
